title: /api/project-activity
responsibility: Serves the activity of the repository this site is hosted for; it only reads.

outputs.name: GET
outputs.description: Resolves to a JSON Response for the value returned by `siteActivity()`, falling back to `{status: 'unavailable'}` only when it is nullish; the HTTP status is 200 for truthy values and 503 otherwise, with `cache-control: no-store`.

errors.name: siteActivity rejection
errors.description: A rejection from the awaited `siteActivity()` call propagates from `GET` because this handler has no catch; its concrete error value is determined by that call.
